name: vLLM
description: High-throughput inference and serving engine for LLMs.
summary: vLLM allows AI-assisted contributions but requires a human submitter who understands and can defend the change, reviews every changed line, and runs the relevant tests, with the PR description stating that AI assistance was used. Fully autonomous code-agent pull requests are not allowed.

evidence.quote: These instructions apply to **all** AI-assisted contributions to `vllm-project/vllm`.
Pure code-agent PRs are **not allowed**. A human submitter must understand and defend the change end-to-end.
The submitting human must review every changed line and run relevant tests.
PR descriptions for AI-assisted work **must** include:
Clear statement that AI assistance was used.
Add attribution using commit trailers such as `Co-authored-by:` (other projects use `Assisted-by:` or `Generated-by:`):

rules.note: AI assistance with code is allowed when a human submits, reviews every changed line, runs tests and discloses the AI use in the PR description.
